value: Furry femdom battle game with squashing, grossdom, shrinking and transformation elements. Contains mouse motion input spells and QTEs.

In a world where witches are the most powerful beings, giant cobra woman Viviane is bored of her daily life and decides to recruit an apprentice. You play as Justine, a little bunny girl who is determined to defeat her in a duel and become her new apprentice. However, should you lose in the duel, you will become her slave instead.
Battle minigiantess characters by casting spells using mouse movements, and dodging attacks with various quick-time events.
